messages:
jordan: seeing a sudden 503 spike on /v1/generate starting ~01:10 UTC, p50 fine but p95-p999 shooting up, ~12% 5xx in the last 8m :warning:
amira: thanks — do we have a customer pattern or is it multi-tenant? any geo skew?
sanket: early signal shows most errors from eu-west ingress nodes, but a few us-east too. looks like connection resets from NLB + backend 504s. attaching quick log snippet:
```
2025-10-03T01:12:14Z ERROR proxy compress: upstream reset: read tcp 10.0.1.12:443->10.2.3.4:52498: read: connection reset by peer
request_id=abc123 model=gpt-l-lite route=/v1/generate cust=big-retailer
```
eric: the big-retailer job kicked off a burst of long-seq requests ~01:09, many with max_tokens=4096. Could be fanout -> backend queueing -> auth proxy timeouts.
maya: CS flagged latency and billing spike for that customer around same time, they were doing bulk evals in EU.
jordan: repro plan — replicate with a customer-like burst: 50 concurrent requests, seq_len ~3k, small inter-arrival. can someone run a targeted replay in staging? tag eng-runtime?
amira: running a quick synthetic in staging now with 40 concurrent, using same batch config and auth header.
ops-bot: infra alert: autoscaler triggered +2 pods for hosted-runtime-eu-west at 01:13 UTC.
sanket: while autoscaler scaled, connection attempts piled at the ingress (ELB/NLB) and some upstreams returned 502/504. I suspect the proxy connection pool exhausted and connection keepalive timeouts popped.
eric: if the proxy pool is the bottleneck, a short-term mitigation is to lower concurrent fanout per request (batch smaller) OR enable fallback to a lower-cost model variant to reduce per-request GPU time.
maya: CS asked for immediate customer mitigation — can we suggest they throttle to 10 rps/instance or use smaller max_tokens for the eval?
oliver: I can push a temporary routing rule: if model==gpt-l-large and seq_len>2000 then route to fallback-gpt-l-medium and return 200 with warning header. Would that help?
jordan: yes that reduces GPU time and should smooth tail latency. let's gate it behind a feature flag and roll to eu-west only for now.
amira: staging repro shows increased 503s when we set keepalive to 15s; lowering to 5s and increasing pool size reduces errors. we should try a small prod experiment on a subset.
sanket: action: open circuit breaker earlier for requests exceeding 2s queue time (owner: sanket).
eric: action: create a temporary routing rule -> fallback for seq_len>2000 in eu-west (owner: eric).
jordan: action: ask CS to contact big-retailer to pause evals for 30m while we stabilize (owner: maya).
ops-bot: deploy started: routing-flag-fallback -> staged to 10% eu-west at 01:28 UTC.
maya: customer paused. they acknowledged and turned off the eval job at 01:20. billing alert suppressed for now.
oliver: deployed breakpoint config to increase proxy pool in eu-west edge by +30% at 01:30, watching metrics.
amira: after routing rollback, p95 dropped from 2.8s to 900ms and 5xx dropped to <0.5% in the eu-west slice.
sanket: root causes -- high-seq heavy customer -> prolonged GPU occupation -> fanout pressure on proxy connection pools + NLB connection resets -> cascade to 5xx/timeouts. also keepalive config on some proxies too aggressive.
eric: postmortem items: 1) add per-customer concurrency caps for long-seq evals (owner: product/solutions) 2) improve ingress pool autoscaling heuristics (owner: eng-sre) 3) default routing fallback for >2k seq (owner: eng-runtime) 4) customer comms template for eval throttling (owner: maya)
jordan: I've created a short runbook entry for 'fanout long-sequence surge' and added the quick mitigation steps (circuit breaker, routing fallback, keepalive tuning). link: https://redwood.internal/infra/runbooks/fanout-long-seq
amira: follow-up: schedule a deeper perf run next week to quantify cost tradeoffs for fallback models and to fine-tune autoscaler thresholds.
oliver: will open a PR for safer default keepalive / pool sizing and add observability for per-request active connections. PR link will be posted in this thread.
maya: thanks all — I'll handle customer comms and confirm when big-retailer resumes.
jordan: closing incident thread after follow-ups created. set calendar for postmortem next Tue 09:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
